k27_rule_review: All 6 validators classified against K27: owner/session 1:1 with checkOwner/checkSessionName (charset regex + shared 128 cap split); prefix 1:1 with the clean-prefix rule (path structure + per-segment charset, dot-only segments excluded structurally since they start outside [A-Za-z0-9]); keys 1:1 with checkKeyShape (clean path + no dot-only segment + free bytes + 512 cap split). Wrappers cover all 15 public methods; sessions, tokens, keys, payloads, write ids, limits and continuations flow as params. Rejection verdicts stay adapter-tested. No K27 rule is contradicted; scope (key inside grant) stays a runtime relation by design.
limitations: Static asserts only (checked, not executed); when-stubs are check-time-only (emitter ignores fixtures; rows execute live at the Q gate). No execution credit claimed (P14 blocked).
